minecraft:falling_block.note: Rendered as the block state's own block model.

minecraft:item.note: No entity model. ItemEntityRenderer renders the item's own item/block model (BakedModel) as a billboard/extruded quad. Use the existing block/item model pipeline.

minecraft:item_frame.note: No entity model. ItemFrameRenderer renders the block models minecraft:block/item_frame and minecraft:block/item_frame_map (present in the client jar under assets/minecraft/models/block/), plus the contained item. Use the block model pipeline.

minecraft:painting.note: No entity model. PaintingRenderer emits a flat WxH quad from the PAINTING_VARIANT registry; see painting-variants.json for every variant's size and texture.
